notes: Stories validated against prior duplicates. No new IDs created beyond feature scope.

change_log.value: Refined schema to include signing + scope enforcement contract
Expanded to include replay + stale token scenarios
Clarified integration points (GPTReader + Azure Functions entry)

stories.title: Define Token Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define bearer token structure including token_id, subject, scopes, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revocation status. Specify signing mechanism, serialization format, and strict validation contract (signature, expiry, scope match) aligned to existing auth.py implementation.

stories.title: Implement Core Token Lifecycle Engine
stories.description: Implement issuance, rotation (version increment + invalidation of prior versions), expiration enforcement (TTL), and revocation checks. Ensure deterministic validation order and consistent rejection behavior across all lifecycle states.

stories.title: Token Enforcement Middleware and Internal APIs
stories.description: Implement FastAPI middleware to enforce bearer token validation on all protected routes. Provide internal endpoints for token validation, rotation trigger, and revocation. Ensure consistent HTTP responses (401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden) and scope enforcement.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Security and Edge Case Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering expired tokens, invalid signatures, replay attempts, rotated tokens with stale versions, revoked tokens, and scope violations. Validate strict enforcement and failure modes.

stories.title: System Integration with GPTReader and Azure Functions
stories.description: Integrate token lifecycle enforcement into GPTReader and Azure Functions entry points. Ensure all inbound requests are authenticated and lifecycle rules (expiration, rotation, revocation) are consistently applied across data pipelines and read operations.

per_feature.mitigation: Reuse existing auth.py patterns and enforce consistent validation order to reduce implementation variance
